findings.title: Relevant LP identity faults preserved mature confirmation evidence and jitter
findings.preconditions: Fresh confirmation1/2 worker already has a saved ordinary window/jitter; pool occupancy read fails/contradicts its bucket, or an Active/Parked physical LP identity is inconsistent.
findings.expected: Persist the affected bucket reset requirement using the existing durable reset/ack path, discard its obsolete jitter and require a confirmed clear before recovery renews the old window.
findings.before_actual: Identity checks fell outside both _bucket reset-catching scopes. The ordinary cycle skipped the bucket but retained mature schedule and no reset requirement.
findings.impact: A quickly recovered provider/identity fault could let the service reuse its earlier sampled window/jitter, contrary to its fault-continuity contract. On-chain price/eligibility/execution guards still apply; no independent financial exploit is asserted.
findings.correction: Zero pool ID and pool occupancy / Active missing LP / Parked retained LP faults enter the existing affected-bucket reset path. New work is not queued after explicit terminal exit. Unrelated share-inventory errors remain independent. Existing clear acknowledgements wait for a healthy reread without repeated paid clears.

verification.persistence_limit: The new save-failure case injects before any write. Existing atomic writer/after-replacement semantics remain source-reviewed and separately evidenced; no power-loss or complete filesystem fault claim.

findings.operator_effect: Actual raw-identity incident can now require the existing reset transaction before continuation; the keeper pays its normal bounded gas. Preserve the journal and use the matching worker/checker rollout. No holder action or manual state edit.

findings.title: Confirmed quality health could outlive final depth or mix head chronology
findings.preconditions: Quality1 observation starts at head100 with confirmations2 and anchor99; latest head retreats to99 during exact-hash metadata reads, or head time/identity becomes contradictory before publication.
findings.expected: Fresh confirmed telemetry must still have required final depth, consistent chronological head/anchor and fresh timestamps; preserve old observation as unavailable on failure, never advance last successful health.
findings.before_actual: Only the initial head was read. An unchanged canonical anchor99 reported observed_this_cycle/head100 even though final actual head99 left depth1. A run cycle could advance last_success_at.
findings.impact: Monitoring/operators could accept falsely current confirmed metadata. This is not a signing bypass: telemetry is diagnostic, and transaction/receipt checks remain separate.
findings.correction: Reread latest head before publication, enforce final depth/nonretreat/same-height identity and time consistency, recheck exact canonical anchor, validate final anchor/head age and export final head. Failures retain prior observation with unavailable state and existing cycle degradation.

findings.operator_effect: One additional latest-head read on a successful quality observation only. Same-cycle reorg, catch-up or failover may report unavailable until a consistent fresh retry. This is deliberately conservative diagnostics; no quote/loss/timing/signing/receipt policy change. Matching source health rollout still required.

remaining.title: Strict sample liveness under the real serial lane remains unqualified
remaining.detail: Pending recovery, multiple bucket windows, actual inclusion/RPC latency and budgets may exhaust the roughly60second margin even after deadline priority. No hidden grace, concurrent signer, new cadence or buffer policy was introduced.

remaining.title: Keeper personal timing and outside ordering risks remain bounded, not eliminated
remaining.detail: Fresh source/range/price floors do not prove that allowed repeated losses or personal trades are unprofitable. Qualify actual independent references, post-withdrawal depth, venues and gas. The selected high-fee pool still needs a cheaper qualified 1% reward conversion route.

remaining.title: Idle-only trigger and outside-range waiting can leave capital idle
remaining.detail: The sample intentionally disables idle-only compounding. Attributed idle is owned NAV, not a surplus; the5% whole-bucket ceiling may block entrants. Do not enable jobs, sweep or weaken guards without reviewed economics/configuration. Early confirmation enrollment and no-swap outside exceptions remain distinct unselected work.

remaining.title: Host/key loss and backup restoration require actual fencing and reconciliation
remaining.detail: Advisory local lock protects one configured host/process lane, not another host with the same key. A stale backup cannot safely invent missing nonce/spend/review history. Real Linux watchdog/cgroup termination, old-host fencing, retained alerts/backups, key rotation and off-host restoration remain unverified. The paused heartbeat was not resumed.

remaining.title: Terminal payouts cannot force a rejecting or inaccessible owner to receive funds
remaining.detail: Governance must initiate and close; bounded keeper allocation/delivery never grants exit authority. Some contract/escrow/dead owners can defer indefinitely and retain owner-only fallback. Paid flags are on-chain; no operator sweep, forged paid cache or arbitrary recipient is supplied.

remaining.title: Retained aliases, logs, snapshots and historical job keys need lifetime operating budgets
remaining.detail: Per-call bounds and four permanent buckets do not bound every lifetime canonical alias or off-host artifact. No unsafe pruning or history cap was added. Plan target gas/backlog/retention and exact relay/recovery workload instead of relabeling a bounded fixture a perpetual guarantee.

remaining.title: Actual services, authority configuration and revenue-bearing economics remain external release facts
remaining.detail: No live feeds/routes/VRF, OpenSea primary-mint path, production addresses, configured fresh4 website or independent audit was created by this source review. Source health hashes identify local files, not attestation or honest provider behavior.
